_about: Short cues for the films, each rendered on its own from silence: whoosh, blip, offer_shimmer, logo_sting (the file names www/video/tools/mix.py looks up by cue). 60 BPM so a beat is a second. Render: cargo run --release -p auracle-wasm --example score -- www/video/sound/stingers.json <out_dir>.
_pitch: The pitched cues avoid anything that clashes with either bed: the shimmer climbs A minor pentatonic (A C D E G), whose notes sit inside both D minor and F Lydian; the blip is an A; the logo sting is Signal's D.
title: Stingers

tracks.name: noise
tracks._why: White noise through a resonant bandpass into a large reverb. Attack and release shortened, the LFO depth zeroed, and the bandpass swept up and back down (0.32, 0.86 at 0.75 s, 0.62) while the note swells and fades: a pass-by.

tracks.name: blip
tracks._why: The explainer's pluck, struck once at A5 for 60 ms with its release knob shortened (0.5 to 0.42): a soft sine click with a glassy top that is gone in a quarter of a second.

tracks.name: shimmer_bell
tracks._why: Eight bell strikes climbing two octaves of A minor pentatonic in 0.63 s, getting louder as they rise.

tracks.name: shimmer_pad
tracks._why: An open fifth (A4 E5 A5) under the bells, faded in over 0.8 s while its cutoff opens from 0.45 to 0.82: the 'grows' in the shimmer.

tracks.name: sting_boom
tracks._why: As in Signal's sting: D1 and D2 sines with a one-octave pitch drop, decay/release set for a three-second cue.

tracks.name: sting_body
tracks._why: The same D2 on the bass preset, so the hit reads on small speakers.

tracks.name: sting_bell
tracks._why: D6 and A6 struck with the boom.
